description.en: An example extension built only on cmux-extension-sdk: each workspace with its working agents and the chats waiting for you, in a sidebar section, and a live feed of workspace, agent and chat events in a pane.

scopes.workspace:read: List your workspaces and hear when one changes.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a workspace when you click its row.
scopes.agent:read: Count the agents working in each workspace.
scopes.agent_chat:read: Count the chats waiting for your answer.
